name: Retouch4me
summary: AI retouching plugins for photographers (Photoshop-compatible, Mac/Windows), sold as perpetual licences per plugin, as full-suite subscriptions with retouch credits, or as cloud retouching in credit packs. Free to try first: two free plugins, three free apps and a demo on every paid plugin.
best_for: high-volume portrait, school and wedding photographers who already live in Photoshop and want repetitive retouching (skin, stray hairs, dust, teeth) automated: owning the plugins outright or renting the whole suite on credits, whichever their volume favours
skip_if: occasional editors: the two free plugins, the free applications and a $24 pack of 100 cloud retouches cover light use; or anyone unwilling to do the three-lane maths, because picking the wrong lane here easily doubles what the same workflow costs
honest_knock: Work out which lane you are in before you pay, because the three lanes price the same photo very differently. One plugin forever at $145 is honest value, but a working portrait stack means four plugins at $145-$179 each, $648 in total, while the Start subscription hands you the entire set for $169 a year with 2,400 retouches included. The catch cuts the other way too: own-forever versus keep-paying is the real decision, since the credits' 5-year rollover only holds 'while the subscription is active' — stop paying and the suite and the stockpile are gone. Low volume? Cloud retouching without a subscription is sold in packs, $24 for 100 retouches, and at $0.15 to $0.24 a photo it is the dearest lane per image, not the cheapest.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-07 on retouch4.me/pricing, and re-read 8 September 2026 while signed in: the signed-in tariff page shows the same three yearly cards, no member-only rate and retouch4.me/products/retouch-plugins) Three ways to pay. (1) Perpetual plugin licences, one-time. The photo collection is fifteen plugins: $145 for Heal, Crop, Face Make, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Skin Mask, Mattifier, White Teeth, Eyes Bundle, Stray Hairs, Fabric, Dust and Color Match; $179 for Dodge & Burn and Clean Backdrop. Outside that collection: Lab $145, Mask Anything $29, the Vectorscope panel $30, video plugins from $124 and 3D LUT Creator Pro from $99. A four-plugin portrait stack (Heal, Crop, Dodge & Burn, Clean Backdrop) is $648 at list. Time-boxed sales run alongside the list: on 7 Sep 2026 Heal showed $108.75 (25% off $145) under a 'Workflow Revamp' promotion putting a different plugin on 25% off each Tuesday of the month. (2) Subscriptions, which include the full plugin set: Start $169 a year, Pro $299, Business $759 — a 'limited offer' against list rates of $20/$35/$90 a month, restated on the cards as $14.08/$24.92/$63.25 a month. They carry 2,400/6,000/18,000 retouching credits and 108,000/300,000/1,200,000 culling credits a year, 20/40/100 GB of MyShot storage, unlimited AI colour correction with batch processing, and a 14-day money-back guarantee that holds while you have used up to 500 retouches. 1 retouch = 1 credit regardless of how many plugins run on the image, and unused credits roll over up to 5 years while the subscription stays active. (3) Credit packs without a subscription: $24 for 100 retouching credits (plus 9,000 culling credits), $59 for 300 (25,000) and $179 for 1,200 (100,000) — $0.24, $0.20 and $0.15 a retouch, each with unlimited AI colour correction for 30 days after purchase. Free: a trial pack of 20 cloud photo retouches on sign-up (no card, seen in the account on 8 September 2026), the Frequency Separation and Color Match Free plugins, the Apex, Photoshop Panel and Arams applications, a Try Demo on every paid plugin, and free cloud retouches for uploading RAWs to their RAW Bank. Re-read 26 September 2026: subscriptions, packs and plugin prices unchanged. New on the page: each subscription now also lists Generative credits (4,800, 12,000 and 43,200 a year on Start, Pro and Business), and a 'Generation Packs' tab sells them one-time at $20 for 2,000, $75 for 10,000 and $132 for 24,000 - while the Start card itself says generative features are 'coming soon in Apex v1'.

exit_test.what: Account and start: the account was created by us and was signed in in his Chrome (retouch4.me/account, interface in English); our AI assistant ran the test from about 14:35 (Amsterdam). The counters in the header at the start: 299 retouching credits, 10 culling, 0 generative and 10 colour. The dossier name is Retouch4me and the review is on AIBM (b2b/retouch4me-review). The audiences from the dossier: High-volume portrait and wedding photographers using Photoshop (solved in part), Occasional editors with light retouching needs (solved in part) and Photographers who want generative editing today (not solved; the alternative is PhotoGenerator). An earlier test on 8 Sep 2026 found that an upload costs 1 retouching credit and the samples are free. Test image: the app offers its own sample photos under No Image? Try one of these; sample 3 was chosen, so no own upload and no portrait of a real person of ours. Deviation: one sample instead of three portraits. The samples are real model photos of Retouch4me, and on every evidence screenshot the whole image area is masked. Core action: retouch4.me/onlineretouch, Online retouch, the cloud retouching in the browser. It has 10 plugins as switches with sliders: Heal, Mattifier, Dodge & Burn, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Eye Vessels, Eye Brilliance, White Teeth, Fabric and Clean Backdrop. Skin Mask is not in the online version. One click on sample 3 gave a result at once, in about 2 seconds, with eight plugins on by default (Heal, Mattifier, Dodge & Burn, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Eye Vessels, Eye Brilliance, White Teeth; Fabric and Clean Backdrop off). The buttons are View original, New Upload and a download icon. Then Dodge & Burn was switched off and Fabric on: the image updated in about 1 second and the counter stayed at 299 after each change. The credit use was 0 for the sample and for 2 changes. The note under the upload zone says: Images will be resized for faster web performance. When uploading a photo you will spend one retouch. An own upload was not done, so that cost was not measured in this test. The result was not downloaded: it is a real model face and was not needed; nothing was saved in the Downloads folder. Plans: Account, Tariffs and packages, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026. Lifetime license per plugin: Heal $94.25 ($145.00 struck through, 35% off this week); Face Make, Crop, Dust, Eyes Bundle, Fabric, Skin Mask, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, White Teeth and Mattifier $94.25 (was $145.00); Clean Backdrop $116.35 (was $179.00). Subscription Start (annual): $20.00 struck through, $14.08 a month, $169.00 billed yearly, 2400 retouches at $0.07 per pc, culling credits 108000, generative credits 4800, up to 5 years while the subscription is active, 1 year with automatic renewal, 14-day money-back guarantee. Pricing page, Business: $63.25 a month, $759 billed yearly, 18 000 retouching credits, 1 200 000 culling credits, 43200 generative credits. Fixed retouch pack (dropdown, no time limit until they run out): Trial Pack $0.00 (20 retouches, culling credits 100, 7 days from activation); Starter $24.00 (100 retouches, $0.24 per pc, culling credits 4500); Advanced $59.00; Extended $179.00. Tax and the total were not seen: Buy pack and Get started lead to the checkout and Buy in one click can charge at once, so the tester did not click through. The public page retouch4.me/pricing was read again just before this delivery the same day and shows the same Start plan ($20, $14.08 a month, $169 billed yearly, 2 400 retouching credits, 108 000 culling credits, 4800 generative credits), the same Business plan ($63.25 a month, $759 billed yearly), the Photo Plugins from $94.25 (was $145) and the sale banner Magic of Numbers. The fixed packs sit in a dropdown that the public page text does not show, so they were not compared again; the amounts above are from the account. The dossier shows the same lifetime and subscription prices. Deviations against the dossier: the Starter Pack has fewer culling credits than the dossier says, the free Trial Pack is not in the dossier, and the sale of 35% off this week is new. Cancelling: retouch4.me/account/settings has only the name, the e-mail address, the newsletter preference and Change password. There is no button to delete the account or to cancel, and My purchases lists only the bought plugins and no subscription, so no cancel route could be tested. Not tested: an own upload (1 credit, according to the note and the test of 8 Sep), Skin Mask, the Photoshop panel, Apex and Arams (desktop, not installed), no AI portrait was made, the download of the result, and the tax and total at checkout. Clean up: nothing was downloaded or deleted; the Downloads folder was checked and held no portrait or result; the account and the credits are unchanged (299); all our tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free sample hides what an own photo costs: the note under the upload zone says an upload spends one retouch, so the first real test of your own photo takes a credit. Skin Mask is not in the online version. The Starter Pack has fewer culling credits than the dossier says, and the pack dropdown is not shown on the public page text. Buy in one click can charge at once, so check the cart before you press it. The account has no cancel or delete button.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

not_tested: An own upload, which costs 1 credit according to the note under the upload zone.
Skin Mask, which is not in the online version, and the desktop tools (the Photoshop panel, Apex and Arams), which were not installed.
The download of the result and the quality of a result on a photo of our own.
Tax and the total at checkout, because Buy in one click can charge at once.
Cancelling or deleting the account; no such button was found and there was no subscription.
Export of a file into a kit, and reimport.

Session and source-reading date: 18 November 2026. Times are CET. The session started at about 14:35 CET. These are approximate tester observations, not benchmark timings. Midnight timestamps are required date anchors, not measured event times.

exit_test.what: Account and start: the account was created by us and was signed in in his Chrome (retouch4.me/account, interface in English); our AI assistant ran the test from about 14:35 (Amsterdam). The counters in the header at the start: 299 retouching credits, 10 culling, 0 generative and 10 colour. The dossier name is Retouch4me and the review is on AIBM (b2b/retouch4me-review). The audiences from the dossier: High-volume portrait and wedding photographers using Photoshop (solved in part), Occasional editors with light retouching needs (solved in part) and Photographers who want generative editing today (not solved; the alternative is PhotoGenerator). An earlier test on 8 Sep 2026 found that an upload costs 1 retouching credit and the samples are free. Test image: the app offers its own sample photos under No Image? Try one of these; sample 3 was chosen, so no own upload and no portrait of a real person of ours. Deviation: one sample instead of three portraits. The samples are real model photos of Retouch4me, and on every evidence screenshot the whole image area is masked. Core action: retouch4.me/onlineretouch, Online retouch, the cloud retouching in the browser. It has 10 plugins as switches with sliders: Heal, Mattifier, Dodge & Burn, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Eye Vessels, Eye Brilliance, White Teeth, Fabric and Clean Backdrop. Skin Mask is not in the online version. One click on sample 3 gave a result at once, in about 2 seconds, with eight plugins on by default (Heal, Mattifier, Dodge & Burn, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, Eye Vessels, Eye Brilliance, White Teeth; Fabric and Clean Backdrop off). The buttons are View original, New Upload and a download icon. Then Dodge & Burn was switched off and Fabric on: the image updated in about 1 second and the counter stayed at 299 after each change. The credit use was 0 for the sample and for 2 changes. The note under the upload zone says: Images will be resized for faster web performance. When uploading a photo you will spend one retouch. An own upload was not done, so that cost was not measured in this test. The result was not downloaded: it is a real model face and was not needed; nothing was saved in the Downloads folder. Plans: Account, Tariffs and packages, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026. Lifetime license per plugin: Heal $94.25 ($145.00 struck through, 35% off this week); Face Make, Crop, Dust, Eyes Bundle, Fabric, Skin Mask, Portrait Volumes, Skin Tone, White Teeth and Mattifier $94.25 (was $145.00); Clean Backdrop $116.35 (was $179.00). Subscription Start (annual): $20.00 struck through, $14.08 a month, $169.00 billed yearly, 2400 retouches at $0.07 per pc, culling credits 108000, generative credits 4800, up to 5 years while the subscription is active, 1 year with automatic renewal, 14-day money-back guarantee. Pricing page, Business: $63.25 a month, $759 billed yearly, 18 000 retouching credits, 1 200 000 culling credits, 43200 generative credits. Fixed retouch pack (dropdown, no time limit until they run out): Trial Pack $0.00 (20 retouches, culling credits 100, 7 days from activation); Starter $24.00 (100 retouches, $0.24 per pc, culling credits 4500); Advanced $59.00; Extended $179.00. Tax and the total were not seen: Buy pack and Get started lead to the checkout and Buy in one click can charge at once, so the tester did not click through. The public page retouch4.me/pricing was read again just before this delivery the same day and shows the same Start plan ($20, $14.08 a month, $169 billed yearly, 2 400 retouching credits, 108 000 culling credits, 4800 generative credits), the same Business plan ($63.25 a month, $759 billed yearly), the Photo Plugins from $94.25 (was $145) and the sale banner Magic of Numbers. The fixed packs sit in a dropdown that the public page text does not show, so they were not compared again; the amounts above are from the account. The dossier shows the same lifetime and subscription prices. Deviations against the dossier: the Starter Pack has fewer culling credits than the dossier says, the free Trial Pack is not in the dossier, and the sale of 35% off this week is new. Cancelling: retouch4.me/account/settings has only the name, the e-mail address, the newsletter preference and Change password. There is no button to delete the account or to cancel, and My purchases lists only the bought plugins and no subscription, so no cancel route could be tested. Not tested: an own upload (1 credit, according to the note and the test of 8 Sep), Skin Mask, the Photoshop panel, Apex and Arams (desktop, not installed), no AI portrait was made, the download of the result, and the tax and total at checkout. Clean up: nothing was downloaded or deleted; the Downloads folder was checked and held no portrait or result; the account and the credits are unchanged (299); all our tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free sample hides what an own photo costs: the note under the upload zone says an upload spends one retouch, so the first real test of your own photo takes a credit. Skin Mask is not in the online version. The Starter Pack has fewer culling credits than the dossier says, and the pack dropdown is not shown on the public page text. Buy in one click can charge at once, so check the cart before you press it. The account has no cancel or delete button.
